hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Southern Asia, group of atolls in the Indian Ocean, south-southwest of India || flat coral atolls, with white sandy beaches; sits atop the submarine volcanic Chagos-Laccadive Ridge || smallest Asian country; archipelago of 1,190 coral islands grouped into 26 atolls (200 inhabited islands, plus 80 islands with tourist resorts); strategic location along major sea lanes in Indian Ocean || Resources: fish || Exports: fish, aircraft, refined petroleum, scrap iron, natural gas (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: flat coral atolls, with white sandy beaches; sits atop the submarine volcanic Chagos-Laccadive Ridge || Southern Asia, group of atolls in the Indian Ocean, south-southwest of India

climate.excerpt: tropical; hot, humid; dry, northeast monsoon (November to March); rainy, southwest monsoon (June to August) || tsunamis; low elevation of islands makes them sensitive to sea level rise

economy.excerpt: upper middle-income Indian Ocean island economy; major tourism, fishing, and shipping industries; high public debt; systemic corruption; crippled by COVID-19; ongoing deflation; poverty has tripled since pandemic began || Exports: fish, aircraft, refined petroleum, scrap iron, natural gas (2023) || Industries: tourism, fish processing, shipping, boat building, coconut processing, woven mats, rope, handicrafts, coral and sand mining

peopleAndCulture.from: People and Society > Languages, Religions, Ethnic groups, Urbanization
peopleAndCulture.excerpt: Dhivehi (official, closely related to Sinhala, script derived from Arabic), English (spoken by most government officials) || Sunni Muslim (official) || homogeneous mixture of Sinhalese, Dravidian, Arab, Australasian, and African resulting from historical changes in regional hegemony over marine trade routes
